tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Fundamental Equations for a Hypersurface] 1. ch8:8.13Let $(M,g)$ be a Riemannian hypersurface in $(\overline M,\overline g)$, and let $N$ be a smooth unit normal field along $M$.

  1. If $X,Y\in \mathfrak X(M)$ are extended to an open subset of $\overline M$, then

    \[ \overline abla _XY= abla _XY+h(X,Y)N. \]

  2. If $\gamma \colon I o M$ is smooth and $X$ is a smooth tangent vector field along $\gamma $, then

    \[ \overline D_tX=D_tX+h(\gamma ',X)N. \]

  3. For every $X\in \mathfrak X(M)$,

    egin{equation} \overline abla _XN=-sX. ag {8.11} \end{equation}

  4. For all $W,X,Y,Z\in \mathfrak X(M)$,

    \[ \overline{\operatorname {Rm}}(W,X,Y,Z) =\operatorname {Rm}(W,X,Y,Z)- rac12(h\owedge h)(W,X,Y,Z). \]

  5. For all $W,X,Y\in \mathfrak X(M)$,

    egin{equation} \overline{\operatorname {Rm}}(W,X,Y,N)=(Dh)(Y,W,X). ag {8.12} \end{equation}

Proof

\sketch Substitution of (8.10) into the general Gauss formulas and Gauss equation gives (a), (b), and (d). The general Weingarten equation gives $(\overline abla _XN)^ op =-sX$, while

\[ \langle \overline abla _XN,N angle = rac12X(|N|^2)=0; \]

hence $\overline abla _XN$ is tangent and (c) follows.

For (e), the unit-length condition gives $ abla _X^\perp N=0$, since $N$ spans the normal bundle. Therefore

egin{align*} ( abla _W^\perp \operatorname {II})(X,Y) & = abla _W^\perp (h(X,Y)N) -\operatorname {II}( abla _WX,Y) -\operatorname {II}(X, abla _WY)\ & =( abla _Wh)(X,Y)N. \end{align*}

The general Codazzi equation then yields

egin{align*} \overline{\operatorname {Rm}}(W,X,Y,N) & =( abla _Wh)(X,Y)-( abla _Xh)(W,Y)\ & =( abla h)(Y,X,W)-( abla h)(Y,W,X)\ & =(Dh)(Y,W,X), \end{align*}

using symmetry of $ abla h$ in its first two tensor arguments.

□
